verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs support a free, no-expiration CRM with self-service data import/transfer, auto-dedup, and workflow automation (hubspot-docs-7, hubspot-docs-9, hubspot-docs-10, hubspot-docs-12, hubspot-docs-26), which together suggest a founder could sign up and get real data into a working pipeline without a partner. However, there is no first-party or independent evidence quantifying setup time (no '<1 hour' claim), and community commentary notes CRM data quality/import friction issues in practice (hubspot-comm-4). Missing for 10: a documented time-to-value benchmark, hands-on founder/independent account of a fast self-serve onboarding, and confirmation that custom-object/API setup isn't needed for a basic pipeline.
